entities.summary: John of Tobolsk, born Ioann Maksimovich Vasilkovskiy was a teacher, writer and clergyman of Ukrainian Cossack origin, who served as the Russian Orthodox archbishop of Chernigov and Novgorod-Seversk, and later as the metropolitan of Tobolsk and all Siberia.
